description: This file implements a logger class 'LangsmithLogger' for integrating with the Langsmith API, including batch logging, credential management, and request handling. It is part of a larger project involving Langsmith integrations within the litellm framework.

classes.name: LangsmithLogger
classes.description: A custom batch logger class for sending logs to Langsmith API, supporting batch processing, credential management, and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: is_serializable
methods.description: Checks if a value is serializable, excluding coroutine, function, generator types, and BaseModel.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LangsmithLogger with optional credentials, sets up batch size, logging queue, and starts periodic flush.

methods.name: get_credentials_from_env
methods.description: Retrieves credentials from environment variables or provided parameters.

methods.name: _prepare_log_data
methods.description: Prepares the log data payload for Langsmith, including metadata, timing, and identifiers.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Synchronously logs a successful event, adding it to the queue and triggering batch send if needed.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful event, adding it to the queue and flushing if batch size is reached.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failure event, similar to success event logging.

methods.name: async_send_batch
methods.description: Handles sending batched logs to Langsmith API, grouping by credentials.

methods.name: _add_endpoint_to_url
methods.description: Constructs API endpoint URLs with versioning.

methods.name: _log_batch_on_langsmith
methods.description: Sends a batch of log data to Langsmith's /batch endpoint.

methods.name: _group_batches_by_credentials
methods.description: Groups queued log objects by their credentials for batch processing.

methods.name: _get_sampling_rate_to_use_for_request
methods.description: Determines sampling rate for logging based on dynamic parameters.

methods.name: _get_credentials_to_use_for_request
methods.description: Selects credentials for a request, either from dynamic params or default.

methods.name: _send_batch
methods.description: Triggers asynchronous batch sending, managing event loop context.

methods.name: get_run_by_id
methods.description: Fetches a specific run's details from Langsmith by run ID.

methods.name: make_dot_order
methods.description: Generates a dotted order string based on current timestamp and run ID.
